board: SparkFun Humidity and Temperature Sensor Breakout - HIH6130 (SEN-11295)
reason: The part check passed on the first run on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test T=27.5C H=42%, circuit-board DRC). The sim encodes the Honeywell 4-byte Data Fetch (status bits 7:6, 14-bit RH, then 14-bit T left-aligned) with readFromZero and fields, and the driver sends the zero-length Measurement Request, waits 40 ms and checks the status bits.
breakoutPinoutSource: SparkFun HIH6130_Breakout_v10 Eagle board file (JP1 pads 1-6 = SDA, SCL, AL_L, AL_H, VDD, GND, silkscreen labels), http://cdn.sparkfun.com/datasheets/Sensors/Weather/HIH6130_Breakout_v10.zip
